onboard.title: Set up in a minute
onboard.subtitle: AQI Menubar reads the air where you are, with your own free aqicn token.
onboard.step1: Open the aqicn token page and enter your email.
onboard.step2: The token arrives by email straight away — no account needed.
onboard.step3: Paste it in Settings. Readings start on their own.
onboard.footnote: Free and open source. The token stays on this computer and is sent only to aqicn.org.

settings.locationNeeded: Enter a city or pick a station.
settings.trayHint: The menu bar changes as you toggle these.
